title: Tali Lanyard Pejabat
subject: a young man alone in his newly rented room in Shah Alam whose curtain rod falls down every night with a crash; on the third night he gives up on the screws, ties the curtain back with his office lanyard and sleeps facing the orange streetlight outside the window
caption: Malay orchestral indie-rock ballad in the 2020s film-soundtrack lane. Clean electric guitar arpeggios washed in reverb; a warm upright piano carrying the chords; a string section that stays low in the verses and swells in the chorus; slow tom-heavy drums entering at the first chorus; a sustained French horn line under the bridge. Cinematic but intimate mix, strings wide, vocal close, a slow build across the whole song. Male tenor, soft and close in the verses, opening to a full chest voice in the chorus. 72 BPM, D major. Tender, gently comic and lonely. No trap, no EDM, no autotune, no rock-kapak guitar solo, no gospel choir.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano and reverb guitar, strings low]

[Verse 1]
Bilik sewa, tingkap satu, langsir biru pudar
Batang besi tersangkut atas dua paku
Pukul dua pagi, bunyi macam pinggan jatuh
Aku bangun, langsir dah terlipat atas lantai

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam pertama, aku pasang semula
Ketuk paku guna tumit kasut

[Chorus]
Langsir jatuh lagi, tak ada siapa dengar
Cuma aku, cuma bunyi besi berguling
Bilik ni senyap, dinding pun belum kenal nama aku
Aku sangkut balik, aku tutup mata

[Verse 2]
Malam kedua, aku pinjam skru dari kedai bawah
Pakcik tu tanya, baru pindah ke, aku angguk saja
Aku pusing skru guna duit syiling
Pukul tiga, besi tu jatuh lagi, tepat atas kaki

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku ketawa sorang dalam gelap
Siapa nak percaya, langsir pun tak nak duduk sini

[Chorus]
Langsir jatuh lagi, tak ada siapa dengar
Cuma aku, cuma bunyi besi berguling
Bilik ni senyap, telefon pun tak berbunyi
Aku sangkut balik, aku kira sampai seratus

[Bridge - French horn and strings, drums drop out]
Malam ketiga aku tak cari paku
Aku tanggal tali lanyard pejabat, ikat langsir ke tepi

[Chorus]
Langsir tak jatuh lagi, tingkap terbuka separuh
Lampu jalan oren masuk sampai ke bantal
Kad nama aku tergantung tepi tingkap
Aku tidur menghadap cahaya tu, malam ni cukuplah

[Outro - piano and guitar, strings fall away]
